notes.title: Important information
notes.notes:
Thanks to everyone who played Tactical Genius at the development stage and after coming out of Early Access. But due to insufficient interest in the game, we've disabled the possibility to purchase in-game currency and stopped updating the game a long time ago. Now we have to make the decision on the shutting down of the game in the nearest future. 

Anyway, we gained valuable experience and we hope to meet you in our new projects.

notes.title: Today "Tactical Genius Online" has come out of Early Access - we invite to the game!
notes.notes:
We thank all those, who have played our game a bit in the stage of Early Access and shared their reviews with us.

We thank even more those, who have played the game a lot, from 100 to 1000 hours, there is quite a number of such players.

In these one and a half years the game has transformed, getting many additional content, units, heroes, different game modes (including tournaments and games vs. AI).

We have spent tens and hundreds of hours discussing the game balance, collecting statistics and playing by ourselves, and then made amendments.

The game still will be loved primarily by fans of multiplayer in turn-based strategies.

We invite new players, who have never heard about the game previously, and those, who have been waiting for the release - now it is the best time for this.

Enjoy the game!

notes.title: Today's updates
notes.notes:
1. Another balancing - some numerical values of units, heroes and altars have been changed.
Improvement of interface: new system of forecasting of potential targets for your and enemy units.
2. New (simplified) system of aiming for archers and long-range attack skills of all units. Now only a hindrance on the nearby hex can interrupt the shot. 3. Previously the hindrances within distances of several hexes also had influence. It was often difficult to calculate and had a non-obvious effect.


Enjoy the game!

notes.title: New damage display system, rebalancing, new altar system - are already in the game.
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! Today we have a lot of updates in the game. These updates are aimed to make gameplay more comfortable and increase dynamics: more interesting (and more risky) early game, reduction the duration of most of games, shortening of the protracted games with a clear advantage of one of the players.

1. Now the damage display system shows how damage is calculated and also allows estimating the damage of enemy units with different variants of their improvements on current turn. You can turn on the extended mode of displaying in the settings.
2. Action principle of altars is changed. Now altars can be captured, after which they give huge bonuses affecting all you units. The struggle for the altars will often be a key factor affecting further win.
3. A lot of changing in balance. For example, forts now give only 25% bonus to damage, priestess has become a support unit with very low attack value, heroes are improved faster - and much more.
4. Now ultimate skill can be upgraded up to two times.

Enjoy the game!

notes.title: Now you can not be afraid of long-drawn games: New mechanics "Famine"!
notes.notes:
Hello!

Today we've added a number of updates, here we emphasize three most important:

1. The mechanics "Famine", which is directed against long-drawn games. After the 25th turn all objects (including capital) are captured in just one turn!
2. Reworks of interface, mainly for improvement of visual perception of the given orders (they were sometimes difficult to distinguish before).
3. We've added different in-game tips (now for players of any level), which can be turned off in settings.

Also we have made several changes in balancing, taking into account the update "Famine".

In the next update we will present more obvious displaying of damage, which dealt to your and enemy units, at the planning stage (with explanations of how it is calculated).

notes.title: Adjust the animation speed in single player game!
notes.notes:
We're glad to inform that now you can adjust the animation speed for single player game in the settings. It is not actual in multiplayer game, but it will be very helpful in game vs. AI.

Also (finally :) ) you can adjust the sound and music volume in the settings.

And, as usual, we've made some changes in units and heroes balancing.

Enjoy the game!

notes.title: The acceleration of creation and resurrection of new units is already in the game!
notes.notes:
The new important update, which will help to fight back after the first failures, has been added in the game: now in case if you has less units than your opponent has in the 1 vs.1 game, you can reset the cooldown for creation (or resurrection) of the next unit using crystals. The price depends on the number of turns, which you want to reduce, and the turn number from the beginning of the game.

We are still working on the balancing of the update called "Heroes" and now all numbers in this update is already more optimal than it was in the first version - you can play each of the heroes and win. Also we sometimes adjust the balance of the old units in light of a new update.

Also we made a few less significant reworks. 

Enjoy the game!

notes.title: Meet the largest game update called "Heroes" and also the revised interface.
notes.notes:
We are pleased to present the very big update called "Heroes". Now every unit in the game corresponds to the certain type of hero. Everybody gets the three basic heroes at the start, the others can be unlocked in the section "Updates".

Hero selected for the duration of the combat can use and improve his or his avatar's active skill. Select Ancient Vampire as a hero, strengthen the selected vampire and get vampirism for all your troops. Select High Archer as a hero, strengthen the selected archer and use the possibility to move one hex further by all units from time to time and etc. This opens up a host of possible combinations.

Briefly about other changes:

- The game interface has been revised. For example, now you can see all of your units in the fort without extra clicks, and much more.
- At start of a game the players should select a hero and also reaffirm the readiness (that eliminates the chance to play with AFK players).
- New objects on the battlefield. Altars give your units temporary bonuses. Mines (as well as forts) give crystals for the strengthening of the heroes. The new templates for the random maps.
- The balancing of units has been reworked due to the update.
- Every hero can be used in the game vs. AI (AI doesn't use heroes).

We could say that we are confidently moving towards the exit of the Early Access period. Balancing, adjusting the settings (including the speed of the animation), the fixing of errors are ahead of us. Also soon we will invite new players more actively. If you like the game, your review can really help us in this matter - tell the others that Tactical Genius is worth the attempt to understand it!
 
Enjoy the game!

notes.title: The announcement of the following updates.
notes.notes:
There are two news: the bad one and the good one.
Start with the bad news: apart from the fact that the last update has been released a long time ago, the next one also isn't expected during the nearest weeks.

And now the good news - the fact is that we're working on a really important for the game comprehensive update. And it's not only the new game mechanics ("Heroes"), which has been described in outline here: 
http://steamcommunity.com/games/TacticalGenius/announcements/detail/597103984568856725
but also the other updates in gameplay (for example, "altars" on the map) and the adoption of the full range of measures to reduce the duration of protracted games. We understand that in the current form, when the duel may take 15 as well as 90 minutes, this discourages many of players and makes the search for an opponent quite difficult. Moreover, the game is suffered from lack of dynamics. We are working on all these issues (that is why we are on Early Access). The first version of the new variant of the game will be released with the update called "Heroes". Then before the release of the basic version of the game we will need to work on interface, balance, errors and possibility to adjust the speed of animation for some time.

We will keep you informed!

A variety of map types with really different location of forts and different dominant types of terrain have appeared in the duel mode. You still can come across the "classical" maps, but from time to time you will meet something new. For example, you can play on a desert map and units will get penalties to defence all over the map. 

New type of terrain - water has appeared in the game. As opposed to mountains, you can shoot through the water.

notes.title: Briefly about current updates.
notes.notes:
Now we are working in two directions, which will seriously affect the game.

First, it is new templates for the random maps. Forts and others map elements will be placed in different ways, accordingly, games will become more diverse. The current template will remain in the game as a "classic".

Second, we are working on global update called "Heroes". Now at the beginning of the round player will choose a hero, who with the gaining of experience will patronize one of units, increasing its characteristics or training his own active skill. This will look similar to the card games, where in addition to the ordinary cards, you play one or another hero defining your style of play. Every type of units will have a hero-patron, every hero will have his own active skill.

For example, a hero of pyromancers will be able not only to increase the characteristics of chosen pyromancer, but improve his own meteor - an ability to attack any place on the map.

A patron of warrior will be able not only to increase the characteristics of chosen warrior for the entire round, but also use spell increasing the damage of all his units for some time.

And etc. Every hero will have his own active skill and a "unit-favorite" whom he can make stronger.

For the improvement of an active skill and increasing characteristics of "favorites", heroes will need mana - a new resource on tactical map.

The game will be to a greater extent predestined by chosen hero and a strategy which will be followed by the player, taking into account the selection of hero. The secondary factors will play less important role.

Those players, who unlocked everything, asked us, on what else they can spend their gold. We reply - initially all players will have only one hero, the patron of warriors. All others could be unlocked by gold. As in the case with units, "the other" heroes in our game aren't stronger than the basic one, but they add the flexibility and new strategies to the game.

Remind that the best help in the development from those who like the game will be a review on the game page.

notes.title: The engineer is already in the game!
notes.notes:
Hello everybody!

The long-awaited update is finally in the game - a new unit "engineer". And this means that now we not only fight, but also build.

The engineer can set towers, walls, mines and fortresses. The ingame tips describe all these skills in details (we remind that in Survival mode all units are initially available to every player).

Below we will focus on several unobvious aspects:

The engineer can use his less powerful skills, such as building of walls (40% from experience for the attack) and setting of mines (80%) to gain experience outside of combat.

Tower is vulnerable to magic attack, but walls are unvulnerable. Walls can be destroyed only by basic attacks or by the player, who controls walls.

The owner of the wall can give an order to its destruction. All walls having received such an order will be destroyed in the beginning of the turn. This opens up to owners of the walls a space for the tactical maneuvers.

All structures can’t be cured, but can be replaced.

We will monitor the game balance and make adjustments. Write us - has it become more interesting to play with new unit? Do you have any suggestions for balancing of the numbers of his skills?

P.S. If you find something that you think is a bug, please, use the button for bug report on this turn (click on the bottom left corner, then on exclamation mark).

notes.title: The major revision of balance and the other updates are already in the game.
notes.notes:
Hey!
 
Since the launch of the first version of the game we've received a lot of feedback that games are "fleeting" and most often the outcome is obvious after the first combat. It's time to engage on this issue. And now you can take a fresh look at the game.
 
There are a lot of updates in the game, we describe only the main of those:
 
1) The basic damage of all units has been significantly (about 1.5 times) reduced. At the same time, now the units which don't participate in the battles restore 5 points of health instead of 10 each turn. The numbers in many units characteristics and skills have also been revised.
2) Now the units damage isn't directly proportional to the amount of health. We had to do this, to not so severely punish player for single mistake or failure. In simple words, now the injured units get weak less than before, and even a unit with 1 point of health represents some threat. We provide the exact formula for those, who need it. The dealing damage of unit, without regard to the defense of target = the basic damage * (0.25 + 0.75 * current health / max. health).
3) The balance in the game mode Player vs AI has been revised, AI units can also get experience each turn, even if they don't take part into the battles. The amount of experience depends on chosen difficulty.
4) Terrain type now gives an increase to defense (for example, +1, +2) instead of increasing the percentage of defense.
5) Now each new level requires 35 experience instead of 50.
 
We will keep a hand on the pulse and rectify the balance as new details are identified. If you have the observations on new balance, you can share these in comments. We can't promise that we'll answer to everyone, but we'll surely read all.
 
We really hope that, with the help of the players, we'll manage to make the game more smart and gentle with regard to the occasional mistakes. And looking forward to the engineer :)

notes.title: The game mode "Free for all" and the improved selection of opponents are already in the game!
notes.notes:
We are pleased to present very important updates for the game!

First, the mode "Free for all" for 4 players has been added in the game.

Think about what you want from the game. We've already had the duel mode for the serious chess confrontation and 2x2 mode for the team play. Do you want joy and fun? You'll get it in the fierce battles "Free for all" for 4 players and even losses will not be upsetting here. It is not your fault, when everybody turns against you :) Diversity of the tactical situations? Try, develop the special strategies which will be more suitable for the mode "Free for all". If you manage to do it, you'll win more frequently than others despite some degree of randomness. You also can earn gold and rating in the mode "Free for all". The chat can be read by all players.

Second, now you can choose the different mods, which you would not refuse to play. You can select the preferences, when you launch the game, for example, you can check boxes next to 1x1, 2x2, "free for all" and start the game vs. AI. You'll get into any game, where sufficient numbers of opponents will be found. Thus, all game modes will become more popular. Also now you can switch the preferable game mods while you are playing vs. AI.

Enjoy the game!

notes.title: New revised Player vs AI mode is already in the game!
notes.notes:
Hello everybody!

Those, who tried to play against AI previously, knew that this mode couldn't be called well-elaborated. We are glad to announce that we've revised this mode, making it much more interesting. We describe the main differences and additions.

1. Now it isn't a survival, it is a battle against AI.
2. The battle takes place on the large map (the same size as in the 2 vs.2 battles), AI attacks top-down (not from all directions as before), using capital and forts for training units.
3. Now AI uses not only skeletons and pyromancers, but also the most part of other units.
4. AI has some bonuses compared with a player, such as the frequency of units’ appearance, the ability to train units not only in fort, but also near it and etc. Total AI power depends on the level of difficulty (see para. 5).
5. You can choose the difficulty before the game. There are levels of difficulty from 1 to 100. The difficulty affects the frequency of enemies’ appearance and also health and attack of skeletons.
6. There is another one small update which also relates to multiplayer: after reaching a level, which has been the maximum previously, units can continue to gain experience. With each new level, unit will increase his normal damage by 1 instead of getting new skills.
7. If you can beat AI, you'll gain rating, depending, in the first place, on difficulty on which you managed to win and, in the second place, on number of spent turns (the less turns, the higher rating). Rating doesn't sum up; your total rating at the end of the week is the highest rating you managed to reach.
8. To play Survival mode is profitable even to those, who prefer multiplayer. Every week Survival top (which will be based on rating) is renewed, and all players, who have managed to reach the top, gain the gold (the higher place in the top, the more gold). The gold still can be spent on unlocking new units in the multiplayer mode.

Attention! The first reward will be given on the following Monday. For the next few days you can receive up to 1000 gold without a serious competition - take your chance! In the future this can become harder - you will have to wait for the whole week and there will be more competitors for the positions in TOP for this period.

Just in case, we remind that the most interesting experience in Tactical Genius you can get in multiplayer battles. We view the single-player mode as a method to mix up the gameplay and brighten up the waiting time for an opponent. However, now this mode became enough elaborated to be interesting by itself.

Further we will work on Engineer and new game mode "All against all" for 4 players.

- Working on "Technologies" - the possibility to use not only units, but also the special skills during the battles.

Enjoy the game!

notes.title: Сегодняшние обновления: новый юнит, багрепорт. Будущие планы.
notes.notes:
После длительного периода с отсутствием видимых результатов, мы, наконец-то, можем рассказать о новом юните (уже введён в игру) - священнице. На самом деле, мы проделали очень большую сопутствующую работу. Надеемся, что обновления (в том числе новые юниты) будут появляться всё чаще и чаще. Следующего юнита (паладина) мы надеемся ввести в течении 1-2 следующих недель. Напоминаем, что ознакомиться с любым юнитом сейчас можно в режиме выживания.

Мы сделали более удобную систему уведомления об ошибках. Если вы уверены, что встретили ошибку, пожалуйста, воспользуйтесь кнопкой уведомления об ошибках (для этого откройте настройки снизу слева экрана и выберите верхнюю кнопку). Опишите баг как можно подробнее. Так же, если вы воспользуетесь этой функцией, мы получим скриншот, и, если возможно, последнее сохранение в вашей партии. В будущем мы выделим самых полезных (в плане отслеживания ошибок) игроков и наградим их игровой валютой.

На стадии обсуждения новый режим игры, который, как нам кажется, понравится многим - режим с большой картой на 8 игроков, “все против всех”. К такому режиму можно будет относиться по разному - можно расслаблено получать фан (всё равно при таком количестве игроков очень велик фактор случайности). В этом случае игрок не получит горечи от поражения, которая всегда присутствует в режиме дуэли. Можно же играть на победу и наслаждаться тем, как вы справляетесь сначала с соседями, а потом с единственным оставшимся игроком, который также захватил половину карты. Пишите в комментариях, что думаете - интересен ли вам этот режим, или же вам кажется что он не отвлечёт вас от дуэли или игр 2 на 2?

Прежде чем делать этот режим, мы должны улучшить режим “выживание”, добавив в него других героев, кроме мага, под управление компьютера, а также отбалансировав. Понятно, что собрать партию на 8 человек не так просто, и тут важно, насколько интересно играть в “выживание” пока партия собирается. Впрочем, одно связано с другим, более серьёзная балансировка режима “выживание” будет нужна когда мы введём ещё трёх юнитов (паладина, инженера, антимага).

Да, будет ещё много балансировок, как после введения священницы, так и после других юнитов. Мы также работаем над системой отслеживания статистики использования разных юнитов и скиллов, чтобы балансировать было удобнее. Ещё раз подчеркнём, что больше внимания балансу надо будет уделять после ввода ближайших юнитов.

Приятной игры!

notes.title: Today’s updates: a new unit, bug report. Future plans./Сегодняшние обновления: новый юнит, багрепорт. Будущие планы.
notes.notes:
1.   	After a long period of lack of visible results we finally can tell you about a new unit (which has already been added in the game) - the priestess. In fact, we have done a great supporting job. We hope that the updates (including new units) will appear more and more frequently. We hope to add the next unit (the paladin) during the next 1-2 weeks. Remind that now you can get acquainted with any unit in Survival mode.

2.   	We have developed a new system of error notifications. If you are sure that you find an error, please, use the error notification button (for that open the settings in the bottom left corner of the screen and click on the top button). Describe a bug as detailed as possible. Also, if you use this function, we will get a screenshot and (if it possible) your last game save. In the future we will reward the most helpful (in relation to the error monitoring) players with some in-game currency.

3.   	There is a new play mode at the stage of discussion that will please, as we think, many of players - the mode with the large map for 8 players, "all against all". It can be treated differently - you can calmly have fun (anyway, with so many players, the random factor is too big). In this case, a player won't taste the bitterness of defeat, which is always present in duel mode. On the other hand, you can play with the aim of victory and enjoy that you defeat neighbors first, and then the last remaining player, who has captured the other half of the map. Leave comments, what do you think about it - do you interested in this mode or you deem, that it won't be able to distract you from duels and 2x2 mode?

4.   	Before we start to develop this mode, we should improve Survival mode by adding other units controlled by computer (in addition to the pyromancer) and balance it. It is clear that to put together 8 players for game is not so easy, thus it's important how interesting to play Survival mode, while you're waiting for opponents. However, one is linked to the other, and a more serious balancing will be needed when we add three more units (the paladin, the engineer and the anti-mage).

5.   	Yep, there will be a lot of balancing after adding both the priestess and the other units. We're also working on a system of statistics monitoring of using different units and skills to make balancing more practical. We would like to emphasize once again that it will be necessary to focus more on balance only after the nearest adding of units.

Enjoy the game!

notes.notes:
Sorry for the long break in activity. Unfortunately, we have come to that point, where we work hard but can't nothing to add in the game neither now nor in the coming days.

There is only one consolation: as soon as our replenished team pulls together, the tempo of the development will be accelerated.

In order to make the waiting less boring, we will add new units one at a time. The first unit will be a priestess, finally it will be possible to be healed not avoiding the battles. It is difficult to set the time frames, so one may speak only of the approximate time - 2-3 weeks. On the plus side, after that, as we hope, new units will be added at regular intervals.

Another project we have in development is "Global skills", yet at the level of conception. "Global skills" (probably it will have a different name) will be unlocked in the main menu for coins, just like you unlock new units now. But any specific branch of skills would have to be increased during the battles (the approximate analogies are "civics" in "Civilization 5" and "skills" in "Heroes of Might and Magic"). I.e., during the game a player would have to experiment not only with the combination and the sequence of the selection of units, but - in parallel with the selection of units - with the selection of the global skills in the current game.

We will continue to keep you up to date with news. We ourselves can't wait to play with a priest, engineer, anti-mage and defender, and also with "Global skills". It is regrettable that all this moves forward not as rapidly as desired, but we do everything to speed up the process.

_________________________________________________


Извиняемся за длительный простой. К сожалению, наступил такой момент, когда мы много работаем, но ничего не можем ввести в игру -  как сейчас, так и в ближайшие дни.

Утешение одно: как только пополеннная команда сработается, темпы разработки существенно ускорятся.

Для того, чтобы ждать было не скучно, мы будем вставлять в игру юнитов по одному. Первой в игре появится священница, и наконец-то лечиться можно будет не только избегая битвы. Сроки появления сказать очень трудно, поэтому можно говорить только примерно “2-3 недели”. Зато после этого новые юниты будут (мы надеемся) появляться с регулярной частотой.

Также на уровне концепции в разработке у нас “Глобальные умения”. “Глобальные умения” (наверное, в итоге это будет называться как-то иначе) надо будет открывать в основном меню также, как открывают новых юнитов - за монеты. В бою же надо будет прокачивать ту или иную ветку умений (из отдалённых аналогий - “Цивики” в “Civilization 5” и “навыки” в серии “Heroes of Might and Magic”). То есть во время партии игрок должен будет экспериментировать не только над комбинацией и порядком наборов юнитов, но и - параллельно набору юнитов - над выбором глобальных скиллов в текущей партии.

Мы будем держать вас в курсе новостей и дальше. Нам самим действительно не терпится поиграть со священником, инженером, антимагом и защитником, а также с “Глобальными скиллами”. Жаль, что это не получается так быстро как хотелось бы - но мы делаем всё что можем, чтобы ускориться.

notes.title: Coming soon: “Survival Genius” mode :) / "Гений Выживания" в ближайших обновлениях :)
notes.notes:
Hello everybody!

We want to announce an important update, which will help to solve several key problems. This is just a preliminary description because the update is under development for the moment and some of the details can be changed in the future.

Play against computer mode will appear in the game, it will be called Survival. In this mode, you, controlling all available types of units in the game, will beat off from advancing hordes of enemies (which will be controlled by computer). Mainly you will be attacked by skeletons, but you will also deal with the heroes from the game. Moreover, the longer you last, the stronger your enemies become.

There will be your capital in the center of the map, neutral forts (in this mode you also will want to increase the unit limit) will be scattered across the map. Enemy forces will come from different parts of the map, primarily they will want to capture the capital, but they also won't refuse from your forts.

The longer you last, the higher your score. There will be corresponding survival TOP, which will allow players to know the usernames of those, who will last longer than all of others.

Why do we need it?

1.   	The mode promises to be fun and dynamic in itself. You don't have to wait for computer opponents, and by the end of such games there will be serious showdowns on the battlefield :)
2.   	We will find out, how much this mode will be needed. We have a number of ideas for the development. For example, what about a cooperating survival?
3.   	We were asked about the opportunity to experiment with the different types of units to decide, which ones are better to be bought in the first place. Survival mode will allow you to experiment ;)
4.   	It is also important that this mode is intended to brighten up the waiting for opponents for duels. You'll be able not only look at the monitor or distract from the game while waiting, but play the Survival mode. If the opponent search option is activated while you are playing the survival mode, as soon as someone else will want to play 1 vs. 1, you will switch from the survival mode to multiplayer game with this player. Also, we plan that such interrupted games will be saved and you will have the ability to finish playing later. Maybe we won't introduce it with the first version of the survival mode, but this will be added in the future updates.
5.   	We also hope thereby to solve two persistent problems: search of opponent in different time (when players exit the game, don't waiting for an opponent) and a request to singleplayer mode from most of the beginners. In any case, we still view Tactical Genius as a multiplayer game. But, probably, thus we can demonstrate the game for a greater number of players. Many of them will want to try their hand at multiplayer game over time.

We hope to add Survival mode in its first simplified form approximately on October 2 and work at the details later.

What do you think about it?

_____________________

Всем привет! 

Хотим анонсировать важное обновление, которое может помочь решить сразу несколько ключевых проблем игры. Описание предварительное, так как обновление в разработке, и детали ещё могут измениться.

Итак, в игре появится режим игры с компьютером - выживание. В этом режиме вы, управляя всеми юнитами что сейчас есть в игре, будете отбиваться от наступающих полчищ противника (управляемых компьютером). По большей части нападать на вас будут скелеты, но будут и герои из игры, причём чем дольше вы продержитесь - тем сильнее станут враги. 

В центре карты будет Ваша столица, нейтральные форты (в этом режиме вы тоже захотите поднять лимит на содержание юнитов) будут разбросаны по карте. Враги будут наступать с разных концов карты, в первую очередь пытаясь лишить вас столицы, но не отказываясь и от ваших фортов.

Чем дольше вам удастся продержаться - тем больше очков наберёте. Появится и соответствующий ТОП по выживанию чтобы игроки знали ники тех, кто смог продержаться дольше других.

Зачем это нужно?

1. Режим обещает быть весёлым и динамичным сам по себе. Компьютерных оппонентов не нужно ждать, а к концу таких игр разборки на поле боя будут нешуточные :)
2. Мы проверим, насколько режим будет востребован. Есть ряд идей по развитию - например, как насчёт кооперативного выживания?
3. Нас просили о возможности поэкспериментировать с разными юнитами, чтобы решить на каких стоит тратить золото в первую очередь. В режиме survival вы как раз и попробуете. ;) Для мультиплеер игр юнитов по прежнему нужно будет открывать за золото.
4. Очень важно, что этот режим предназначен, в том числе, для скрашивания ожидания противников для дуэлей. Вы сможете не просто смотреть на экран или отвлекаться от игры на время ожидания, а поиграть в режим выживания. Если у вас в режиме выживания будет активирована опция поиска дуэли, то как только кто-то иной захочет поиграть 1 на 1, вы отправитесь из режима выживания в мультиплеер игру с этим игроком. Также, возможно, мы не сделаем это к первой версии выживания, но со временем прерванные партии будут сохраняться, и вы сможете их доиграть позже. 
5. Также мы надеемся таким образом решить две вечных проблемы игры - поиск противников в разное время (когда люди выходят так и не дождавшись), и запрос многих новичков на синглплеер. В любом случае, мы по прежнему рассматриваем “Гения Тактики” как в первую очередь мультиплеер игру. Но, вероятно, таким образом мы сможем продемонстрировать игру большему количеству игроков. Многие из них со временем захотят попробовать свои силы и в мультиплеере.

Мы надеемся ввести игру режим Survival в своей первой, упрощённой форме, примерно 2 октября, и поработать над деталями позже.

Что думаете?

notes.title: Development News/Новости разработки на русском
notes.notes:
Hi everybody!

We hope that most of you have already played the game in free-to-play mode and can admit that it is a good way to maintain the online.

We want to tell you what we are doing now.

At the moment we are adding four new units. We have given a lot of thought to that and now our game artists are working hard by sweat of their brow. We should emphasize that new units are not all what we are planning to add in the game; however, it is expedient to deal with this in the nearest updates.

We will briefly describe the features of new units and their effects on gameplay. But we emphasize, that everything might be changed, even the names.

Paladin (or Defender). We wanted to help those players, who prefer to play with a focus on defense. This character will be one of their favorite units. Paladin lacks behind Warrior in fighting capabilities in an open field, but he gets different bonuses near your forts. He will also have a temporary invulnerability, as befits a paladin. Thus, he will be a defense-oriented fighter, and his ultimate skill will significantly enhance the defense of allied units all over the map.
Priest. This unit is introduced in order to give more chances to survive for injured units. In addition to various types of healing, priest will have an ability to enhance the initiative of injured allies, it might help them to leave the battlefield and survive. Priest's ultimate skill will reset the global timer which prohibits ordering new units. Do you want to resurrect someone? No need to wait, with a priest you can do it immediately.
Engineer is a unit, which can affect gameplay and transform it beyond recognition. Set the invisible mine (and detect the enemy's ones), build impassable, but destructible walls, build towers, which will shoot in the enemies - all that you can do with an engineer! Engineer's ultimate skill will allow you to build towers - neither more nor less. Towers give bonuses in the battle (similar to bonuses from forts), but can be destroyed, if enemy enters it. Does it sound serious? Yes, this unit's characteristics need to be well thought to ensure that playing against him won't be unbearable. But anyway, it will be interesting.
Anti-Mage (Witcher)... well, you get it. Using magic and skills next to him will be severely punished. By using his ultimate skill witcher can put a spell of silence (similar to archer's Silence) on enemies all over the map. Yep, no magic.

Write, what you think about all these units. Which one seems to be more interesting? How better - Paladin or Defender? Anti-Mage or Witcher?

***

Всем привет! 

Надеемся, многие уже попробовали игру в free to play режиме и могут согласиться, что для поддержки онлайна это неплохой вариант.

Хотим рассказать, чем мы сейчас занимаемся.

А занимаемся мы добавлением четырёх новых юнитов. Мы закончили с их обдумыванием, и сейчас художники их уже рисуют в поте лица. Нужно подчеркнуть, что в игре будут появляться не только новые юниты, но в ближайших обновлениях есть смысл заниматься именно ими.

Мы расскажем коротко, в чём суть юнитов, и как они повлияют на игровой процесс. Но подчеркнём, что всё ещё может поменяться - даже название.

Паладин (или же Защитник). Мы хотели помочь игрокам, предпочитающим играть от защиты. И этот персонаж будет у них одним из любимых. Уступающий воину в открытом бою в чистом поле, он будет получать самые разные бонусы возле ваших точек. Будет у него и временная неуязвимость, как и подобает паладину. Так как это воин, ориентированный на защиту, его ульт будет значительно повышать защиту всех союзных воинов на карте.
Priest, он же священник, или жрец. Этот юнит вводится с целью дать больше шансов на спасение раненым. Помимо различных видов лечения как такового, можно отметить возможность священника поднять инициативу раненым союзникам - зачастую это позволит им покинуть поле боя и выжить. Ульт священника будет обнулять счётчик до появления нового юнита. Хотите кого-нибудь воскресить? Зачем ждать, со священником это можно сделать сразу.
Инженер - юнит, который, возможно, повлияет на игровой процесс и изменит его до неузнаваемости. Установка невидимых для врага мин (а также поиск мин вражеских), строительство непроходимых но разрушаемых стен, строительство башен которые будут стрелять во врагов - с инженером будет, что построить! Ульт инженера, ни много ни мало, будет позволять строить крепости. Крепости будут давать бонусы в бою, аналогичные фортам, но рушиться если на них наступит враг. Звучит очень серьёзно? Да, надо будет балансировать характеристики инженера, чтобы играть против него не стало совсем невыносимо. Но в любом случае, это будет интересно.
Антимаг (ведьмак) - ну, вы поняли. Пользоваться магией и скиллами рядом с этим парнем будет строго наказуемо. Ульт антимага будет накладывать “молчание”, подобное антимагии лучника, на всех противников на карте. Да, никакой магии.

Пишите, что думаете про всех этих юнитов. Какой вам кажется наиболее интересным? И да - паладин или всё-таки защитник? Антимаг или всё-таки ведьмак? Священник или жрец?

notes.title: (For Russian players): Tactical Genius переходит на Free to Play
notes.notes:
Дублируем предыдущую новость, но на русском.

Всем привет!

У нас сегодня важная новость.

Учитывая ситуацию с онлайном, мы планируем перевести игру на free to play модель. Мы уже придумали интересную модель, в которой, как нам кажется, все будут довольны - в неё можно будет играть как бесплатно, так и за деньги. 

Что теперь будет у новых игроков в начале игры?

Все новые игроки на старте получат трёх базовых юнитов, которые сейчас есть в демоверсии: воин, лучник, маг. 

Можно ли будет играть бесплатно?

Да, с успехами в игре игроки будут получать монеты, которые можно будет потратить на покупку новых юнитов. Игрок сам сможет выбрать, какого юнита он хочет купить, как только заработает монеты - например, первым делом он купит некроманта, и сможет его использовать во всех последующих партиях.

Что будет продаваться за деньги?

Монеты. Для тех кто захочет экономить время и поддержать разработчиков можно будет покупать монеты не зарабатывая их в игре.

А как насчёт баланса?

Мы делаем большую работу над рейтинговыми группами и системой наград. Если вкратце - наша игра устроена так, что и базовыми 3 юнитами можно побеждать тех, у кого выбор больше. Но понятно, что больший выбор даёт больше гибкости. Поэтому тенденция такая, что наибольшие награды (как и наибольший интерес от игры) игрок будет получать в той рейтинговой группе, которая соответствует его количеству юнитов. Так или иначе, вскоре любой игрок будет попадать в такую группу и будет играть с равными.

А что будет со старыми игроками?

Все они получат золота на покупку не 3, а 9 новых юнитов, в том числе из следующих обновлений. Пользуясь случаем, ещё раз выражаем признательность всем тем, кто оценил игру, и тем кто писал отзывы. Мы приносим свои извинения за проблемы с онлайном - ошибка в модели - это наша ошибка.

Когда всё это заработает?

Всё в некоторой степени зависит от steam, но мы планируем около 2 недель.

Зачем всё это?

Мы предполагаем что наша первая модель была ошибочной. Мы очень часто слышали отзывы, что инди игра ориентированная на мультиплеер должна быть f2p, или же в ней должен быть сингл плеер. Так как последнее - точно не подходит “Гению Тактики”, после долгих размышлений мы решили перевести игру на f2p модель. Мы думаем, что теперь будет вполне реально находить противников как в играх 2 на 2, так и 1 на 1. Мы также думаем, что достижение целей в игре (открытие новых юнитов) - это интересно само по себе.

Мы будем держать вас в курсе событий!

notes.title: Tactical Genius switches to free-to-play model
notes.notes:
Hello everybody!
 
We have important news today.
 
Considering the current situation with online, we plan to switch the game to free-to-play model. We have already come up with interesting model which we believe will meet everyone's needs - you will be able to play both for free and for real money.
 
What will new players get at the beginning of the game now?
 
All new players will get the three basic units, which are currently available in the demo version of the game: warrior, archer and pyromancer.
 
Will it be possible to play the game for free?
 
Yes, as you progress through the game, you will gain the game currency, that can be spent on the purchase of new units. When a player earns enough game currency, he will be able to choose himself what type of unit he wants to buy. For example, he can buy necromancer and use it in all subsequent rounds.
 
What will be sold for real money?
 
The game currency. Those who want to save time and support the developers can purchase the game currency instead of earning it.
 
What about balance?
 
We are working hard to develop a system of rewards and rating groups. In short, our game is arranged in such a way that you can defeat opponents with a wide choice of units by using only 3 basic units, but, of course, a greater choice provides a greater flexibility. In general, the tendency is so that player receives the highest rewards (as well as the greatest interest in the game) in that rating group, which corresponds to the number of his units. Anyway, any player will shortly get into such group and fight against equal opponents.
 
What will happen to the old players?
 
We'll give you the gold in sufficient quantity to purchase not 3, but 9 new units, which will be added in the future updates. Taking an opportunity, we would like to thank once again those of you who appreciated the game and wrote reviews. We apologize for the problems with online, the wrong choice of model  is our mistake.
 
When will everything be working?
 
This depends to a certain degree on Steam, but we plan to release in about 2 weeks.
 
What is this all for?
 
We suppose that our first model was mistaken. We have often read reviews which stated that multiplayer indie game should be f2p or it should have a single player mode. As the last statement isn't at all well suited to Tactical Genius, after serious consideration, we've decided to switch the game to f2p model. We think, this will allow players to find opponents for 2x2 games as well as 1x1 games. We also think that achieving the goals in the game is interesting in itself.
 
We will keep you informed on progress!
